overall_summary: Deduplicated performance analysis indicates that 'What If' space scenarios and extreme planetary anomalies (e.g., diamond planets, extreme dark/ice worlds, and unusual cosmic metrics) heavily outperform standard biology or generic psychology facts. Videos utilizing counter-intuitive existential questions ('What If You Fell Into...') combined with high-value planetary hooks generate significantly higher views-per-day and stronger like-to-view ratios compared to older static factoids.

winning_patterns.pattern: Hypothetical Space Immersion ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like IYuce8vaU3Y ('What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?', 1,029 views) and 8KEl0_pJ_68 ('What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?', 972 views) demonstrate rapid velocity and strong engagement within days of publication.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on hypothetical planetary immersion formats, focusing on extreme physics environments that trigger strong visual curiosity.

winning_patterns.evidence: QXuqYERlqSo ('This Planet Rains Supersonic Rubies!', 725 views) and v1rrcZLdp4U ('The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b', 1,031 views) prove that rare, visceral meteorological phenomena on alien worlds drive superior retention and sharing.
winning_patterns.action: Continue sourcing bizarre, verifiable exoplanet conditions (e.g., strange precipitation, extreme density, or gravitational anomalies) for future scripts.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like Jc04LVKNd2s ('The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head', 17 views) and 2fqaGqfsR4A ('Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories', 5 views) show near-zero traction over extended periods.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize abstract internal psychology facts unless framed through a high-stakes, cinematic, or bizarre human survival lens.

weak_patterns.evidence: F1kXwuXuNgo ('The Only Animal That Can Live Forever', 69 views) and 5AN7LUgqarc ('Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories', 53 views) underperform relative to cosmic horror and space-what-if formats.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal-related concepts entirely into cinematic animal survival or high-tension predator/prey micro-narratives rather than standard listicle facts.

next_video.concept: What Happens If You Step Foot on a Rogue Planet Traversing Interstellar Space Without a Star?

fresh_topic_constraints: Must not use diamonds, rain, ice, sharks, octopuses, or head-vs-feet aging.
Must introduce a completely new astronomical entity (interstellar rogue planet concept).
Must maintain factual accuracy regarding astrophysics and planetary science.

experiment: Test a 15-second pacing structure with a cold open lacking any channel intro, jumping straight into the 'What If' consequence within the first 1.5 seconds to maximize audience retention at the critical 0-to-3-second mark.
